resources.string: You are exploring Tandem with sample recipes. What you do here stays on this phone and is removed when you connect your own Tandoor.
Tandoor is a free recipe manager that you host yourself. Try Tandem in demo mode first, or read how to set up Tandoor.
Check that the phone is online and try again.
Check the address. If the server can only be reached at home, connect to your home network or VPN.
It took too long to get an answer. Try again in a moment.
If your server uses its own certificate authority, install that certificate in the Android settings (Security, Encryption and credentials) and try again.
The server\'s certificate does not match the address, or a secure connection could not be set up.
Enter the full address, for example the one you open Tandoor with in the browser.
Tandem only connects over https:// so that your login cannot be read on the way.
This does not look like Tandoor
The server answered, but not like a Tandoor server. Check the address and any path after the domain name.
Your login on this device is no longer valid. Nothing you saved offline is lost.
Something in front of the server, such as a firewall or proxy, blocked the request. Tandem will try again later.
It may have been deleted on the server.
The server did not accept this
Check what you entered and try again.
The server limits how often you can try. Wait a while before you try again.
The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
The server\'s answer could not be read. This Tandoor version may not be supported yet.
Try again. If it keeps happening, report the problem with the details below.
A crash log was saved on this device. Nothing has been sent. If you want to report the problem, view the log and copy or share it.
App version, Android version, device model and where in the code Tandem stopped. Passwords, tokens and web addresses are removed.
